sent by software

  • CURIE: gmeow:sentBySoftware
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/sentBySoftware
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/email

The software agent that sent a message, when parsed and identified from the User-Agent or X-Mailer header. The raw header value remains on gmeow:userAgent (Principle 4).

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:EmailMessage -> gmeow:SoftwareAgent

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:sentBySoftware from gmeow:EmailMessage to gmeow:SoftwareAgent when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:EmailMessage, gmeow:SoftwareAgent
